input.jobDescription:
Backend Engineer at Launchpad

Hey! We're Launchpad, a seed-stage startup building the next generation of developer tooling. We're a tiny team (5 people) moving fast and shipping constantly.

You'll be:
- Hacking on our Go backend services
- Designing and owning Postgres schemas
- Building async job queues with Redis
- Integrating third-party APIs (Stripe, SendGrid, Twilio)
- Deploying to production multiple times a week
- Making architecture decisions — no one will micromanage you

You should be comfortable with:
- Go (or a strong desire to learn it fast)
- PostgreSQL — you love SQL, not afraid of query plans
- Docker and basic AWS (ECS or Lambda)
- Working in a messy, fast-moving codebase

Bonus points for: experience with developer tools, CLI apps, or open source contributions.

This is a full-time role. We're remote-friendly. Shoot us your GitHub and a note at jobs@launchpad.dev
